name: Grade 7 IIIT Practice: November Week 12 - Presentation
description: Practice words for presenting the final system.

words.definition: A model or pretend version used to show how something works.
words.example: The simulation showed how the sensor system would work.

words.definition: Information that shows what happened or supports an idea.
words.example: The evidence included the test table and screenshots.

words.definition: What happens at the end of a task or test.
words.example: The result showed the alert worked at the chosen distance.

words.definition: A task that takes effort to complete.
words.example: The challenge was keeping the Bluetooth connection stable.

words.definition: A change that makes something better.
words.example: The improvement made the signal easier to see.

words.definition: Thinking about what happened and what you learned.
words.example: The reflection explained what the group learned from testing.
